## Loading Libraries

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmnet)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
```

## Reading the Dataset

```{r}
df <- read_csv("../data/mini_project2_data/Data_Carrardetal2022MedTeach.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

head(df)
```
## Check for missing data
```{r}
# Count of missing values per column
colSums(is.na(df))

```

## create combined burnout score
```{r}
# Reverse-code professional efficacy
max_ea <- max(df$mbi_ea, na.rm = TRUE)
df$mbi_ea_rev <- max_ea - df$mbi_ea

# Create a combined burnout score

# Z-score standardization
df$mbi_ex_z <- scale(df$mbi_ex)
df$mbi_cy_z <- scale(df$mbi_cy)
df$mbi_ea_rev_z <- scale(df$mbi_ea_rev)

df$total_burnout <- df$mbi_ex_z + df$mbi_cy_z + df$mbi_ea_rev_z

```

```{r}
# Remove the outcome and ID columns, and convert predictors to a matrix
predictors <- model.matrix(total_burnout ~ . - id - total_burnout - mbi_ex - mbi_cy - mbi_ea - mbi_ea_rev - mbi_ex_z - mbi_cy_z - mbi_ea_rev_z, data = df)[, -1]
outcome <- df$total_burnout

# Run Lasso
lasso_model <- cv.glmnet(
  x = predictors,
  y = outcome,
  alpha = 1,            # Lasso
  standardize = TRUE,   # Standardizes predictors automatically
  nfolds = 10            # Cross-validation
)

# Plot the cross-validation results
plot(lasso_model)

# Get the best lambda
best_lambda <- lasso_model$lambda.min

# Extract coefficients at best lambda
lasso_coefs <- coef(lasso_model, s = best_lambda)
print(lasso_coefs)

```
```{r}

# Remove ID and burnout score to isolate predictors
predictors_rf <- df[, !(names(df) %in% c("id", "total_burnout", "mbi_ex", "mbi_cy", "mbi_ea", "mbi_ea_rev", "mbi_ex_z", "mbi_cy_z", "mbi_ea_rev_z"))]

rf_data <- data.frame(total_burnout = df$total_burnout, predictors_rf)
rf_data <- na.omit(rf_data)  # Remove rows with NAs


# Fit Random Forest regression model
set.seed(123)
rf_model <- randomForest(
  total_burnout ~ ., 
  data = rf_data,
  importance = TRUE,
  ntree = 500
)

# Print model summary
print(rf_model)

# Plot variable importance
varImpPlot(rf_model, type = 1, main = "Random Forest Variable Importance (MSE Increase)")

```

```{r}
# Extract and rank variable importance
importance_df <- importance(rf_model, type = 1)  # %IncMSE
importance_df <- data.frame(Variable = rownames(importance_df), IncMSE = importance_df[, 1])
importance_df <- importance_df[order(-importance_df$IncMSE), ]

# Show top predictors
head(importance_df, 10)  # Top 10 for review

```


```{r}
# Prepare importance data from your Random Forest model
importance_df <- importance(rf_model, type = 1)
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(importance_df),
  IncMSE = importance_df[, 1]
)

# Get top 10 features
importance_top10 <- importance_df[order(-importance_df$IncMSE), ][1:10, ]

# Make Variable a factor for correct plot order
importance_top10$Variable <- factor(importance_top10$Variable, levels = rev(importance_top10$Variable))

# Plot
ggplot(importance_top10, aes(x = Variable, y = IncMSE)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "seagreen3") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Feature Importances",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Importance (IncMSE)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

```{r}
# Final set of top predictors from both Lasso and Random Forest
top_predictors <- c("age", "year", "stud_h", "health", "psyt",
                    "qcae_cog", "qcae_aff", "erec_mean", "cesd", "stai_t")

# Subset the data to include only those + the outcome
final_data <- na.omit(df[, c("total_burnout", top_predictors)])

# Fit the linear regression model
final_model <- lm(total_burnout ~ ., data = final_data)

# View model summary
summary(final_model)

```

Checking how the years of medical school affect the levels of burnout. 
```{r}

summary_df_efficacy <- df %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean    = mean(mbi_ea),
    se      = sd(mbi_ea) / sqrt(n()),
    lower   = mean - qt(0.975, df = n() - 1) * se,
    upper   = mean + qt(0.975, df = n() - 1) * se
  )

ggplot(summary_df_efficacy, aes(x = year, y = mean)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Years of Study",
    y = "Mean Efficacy",
    title = "Mean Efficacy by Year with 95% CI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
